name: 3d.marutto.art
summary: Gallery of miniature 3D worlds built in the browser: browse 28 scenes and 14 materials, then remix one in the editor.
description: A browser gallery of small dioramas and islands: every world lists its model count and date, has a details page and a one-click reMix that opens it in the editor preloaded. A separate materials library holds 14 reusable 3D models (fish, tree, moon, bus, penguins) with file sizes, each pullable into the editor with one click.
contains: one-click reMix opens a world in the editor
materials can be pulled into the editor with one click
